selected_records.title: LiLib: Lifelong Air-to-Ground Path-Loss Prediction on UAVs via a Drift-Triggered Model Library

article.body:
LiLib paper addresses UAV air-to-ground path-loss prediction

An arXiv paper titled “LiLib: Lifelong Air-to-Ground Path-Loss Prediction on UAVs via a Drift-Triggered Model Library” describes research on path-loss prediction for UAVs. The available record does not establish whether the approach was tested in flight or whether any navigation or other operation was autonomous.

No sensor inputs, payload, test environment, performance results or deployment status are specified in the record. It therefore supports identifying the research topic, but not claims of a demonstrated capability or operational use.
